<p>Code Connect is a bridge between your codebase and Figma’s Dev Mode, connecting components in your repositories directly to components in your design files. When implemented, these connections enhance the <a href="/docs/figma-mcp-server/">Figma MCP server</a>'s ability to guide AI agents with more precise implementation details by giving them direct references to your actual code.</p>
<h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_IzjB" id="code-connect-cli">Code Connect CLI<a href="#code-connect-cli" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Code Connect CLI" title="Direct link to Code Connect CLI" translate="no">​</a></h2>
<p>Make your design system easily accessible to your developers and create a shared source of truth for both the design and code elements.</p>
<p>Our <a href="/docs/code-connect/quickstart-guide/">getting started guide</a> will walk you through the process of setting up Code Connect CLI and publishing your first components. <strong><a href="/docs/code-connect/quickstart-guide/">Getting started with Code Connect CLI →</a></strong></p>
<h2 class="anchor anchorWithStickyNavbar_IzjB" id="code-connect-ui">Code Connect UI<a href="#code-connect-ui" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Code Connect UI" title="Direct link to Code Connect UI" translate="no">​</a></h2>
<p><strong>Code Connect UI</strong> lets you connect components directly within Figma, with GitHub integration for repository access and mapping context. Code Connect UI supports one-to-many connections, letting you map a single design component to multiple code implementations across different frameworks and languages (e.g., React, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, Vue). This makes it easier to scale across both design and engineering teams, with upcoming features like automated mapping and broader framework support. <strong><a href="/docs/code-connect/code-connect-ui-setup/">Getting started with Code Connect UI →</a></strong></p>

In both cases the connections will be used to provide more code context via the Figma MCP server.</p></div></div>
